announcements.title: A Quick Note from the Aniraku
announcements.banner: Thank you for your continued love and support for Aniraku. Some of you reached out about in-app offline downloads — we're listening, and we'd like to hear from you.
body:
Aniraku is a passion project that I maintain alongside my life, and your support keeps it going. As we prepare for V5.8.0, I'd love to know: how much would you value in-app offline downloads without needing an external downloader?

Offline downloads are already available on the Aniraku website and are currently in development for the app.

Beyond downloads, is there another feature you'd like to see in Aniraku? Your feedback helps shape what we build next.

If you're on GitHub, please consider starring the project — it means a lot.

I'm also looking for volunteers to help grow the Aniraku community on Discord or Telegram. I'm not perfect at setting these up myself, so any help would be greatly appreciated. If you're interested, feel free to reach out.

For missing anime titles or any errors you encounter, you can email me directly at sho.islam0311@proton.me.

Thank you for being part of Aniraku. Enjoy your anime.
